description: Implementation of the AeadBaseDecrypter class for handling AEAD decryption in QUIC, including key management, nonce handling, and decryption logic.

classes.name: AeadBaseDecrypter
classes.description: Handles AEAD decryption operations, key and nonce management for QUIC protocol.

methods.name: InitAndCall
methods.description: Initializes BoringSSL and retrieves the specified EVP_AEAD algorithm.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic key for decryption.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Sets the nonce prefix for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Sets the initialization vector for Google QUIC.

methods.name: SetPreliminaryKey
methods.description: Sets a preliminary key for key diversification.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Diversifies the key using a nonce.

methods.name: DecryptPacket
methods.description: Performs decryption of a packet given packet number, associated data, and ciphertext.

methods.name: GetKeySize
methods.description: Returns the size of the cryptographic key.

methods.name: GetNoncePrefixSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the nonce prefix.

methods.name: GetIVSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IV.
